name: Two tabs, the token is about to expire USER_MANAGER = ORIGINAL
description: Both tabs get the "expiring" event within seconds of each other, and the network holds every request for a while. Expected with 'rotationSafe': the first tab locks the refresh token and sends it, the second one finds the token locked, sends nothing and takes the tokens the first one stored; one request, one SSO session, both tabs work. Expected with 'original': every tab sends the shared refresh token on its own, the same token goes to the provider twice (oidc-client-ts #430).

Expected with 'original': every tab sends the shared refresh token on its own, the same token goes to the provider twice (oidc-client-ts #430).
